kpis.description_fr: I&AF = water + transportation + life sciences + advanced manufacturing. Plus gros segment Jacobs post-spin. Tailwind IRA + CHIPS Act.
kpis.description_en: I&AF = water + transportation + life sciences + advanced manufacturing. Jacobs's largest segment post-spin. IRA + CHIPS Act tailwind.

kpis.description_fr: Backlog ~22 Mds $ = ~2 ans CA. Visibilité forte. Mix grands programmes long-terme.
kpis.description_en: Backlog ~$22B = ~2 years revenue. Strong visibility. Mix of large long-term programs.

kpis.signal: Le backlog du segment PA Consulting a augmenté de près de 10 % en 2025.
kpis.description: Le backlog du segment PA Consulting s’élève à 415 M$ au 26 septembre 2025, contre 378 M$ en 2024 et 311 M$ en 2023 (source : Note 19 - Segment Information).

kpis.signal: Le backlog lié aux contrats du gouvernement fédéral américain représente 9,5 % du backlog total en 2025.
kpis.description: Le backlog relatif aux contrats du gouvernement fédéral américain s’élève à 2,2 Mds$ (9,5 % du backlog total) au 26 septembre 2025, contre 2,4 Mds$ (11,1 %) en 2024 et 2,6 Mds$ (14,7 %) en 2023 (source : Note 19 - Segment Information).

kpis.signal: Plus gros segment ~89% CA Jacobs post-Separation, expose IIJA + Advanced Facilities (semicons)
kpis.description_fr: Segment Infrastructure & Advanced Facilities (continuing operations) : ingenierie infra (water, transport, env) + advanced facilities (semicons, sciences vivantes). FY25 sur exercice cloture 26 sept 2025.
kpis.description_en: Infrastructure & Advanced Facilities segment (continuing operations): infra engineering (water, transport, env) + advanced facilities (semicons, life sciences). FY25 ended Sept 26, 2025.

kpis.signal: Backlog record 23.1Mds$ FY25, +29% sur 2 ans, drivers Water/Env/Energy/Cities
kpis.description_fr: Backlog total Jacobs au 26/09/2025 : 23.1Mds$ (I&AF 22.6Mds$ + PA Consulting 0.4Mds$). ~29% reconnu sous 12 mois (6.77Mds$). Visibilite revenu long-cycle.
kpis.description_en: Total Jacobs backlog at 09/26/2025: $23.1B (I&AF $22.6B + PA Consulting $0.4B). ~29% recognized within 12 months ($6.77B). Long-cycle revenue visibility.

kpis.signal: Segment haute marge (~22% OP margin), conseil tech/innovation UK, investissement 65% stake
kpis.description_fr: Segment PA Consulting (Jacobs detient majorite) : conseil tech, innovation, transformation. Marge operationnelle 22% (vs 8% I&AF). Diversification PV.
kpis.description_en: PA Consulting segment (Jacobs majority stake): tech consulting, innovation, transformation. 22% operating margin (vs 8% I&AF). PV diversification.

kpis.signal: OP +13.2% FY25, marge 8.4%, ameliore par mix favorable Advanced Facilities
kpis.description_fr: Resultat operationnel segment I&AF. Marge 8.4% FY25, en hausse via mix Advanced Facilities (semicons, sciences vivantes) plus profitables. NOTE FY24 retraite a 798.4 (basis Separation) vs 632.3 reporte initial dans 10-K 2024.
kpis.description_en: I&AF segment operating profit. 8.4% margin FY25, increased via more profitable Advanced Facilities mix (semicons, life sciences). NOTE FY24 restated at 798.4 (Separation basis) vs 632.3 original 10-K 2024.

kpis.signal: Marge premium 22%, croissance reaccelere FY25 (+16% vs +1% FY24)
kpis.description_fr: Resultat operationnel PA Consulting. Marge ~22% FY25 (premium vs I&AF 8.4%). Reacceleration FY25 apres plateau FY22-FY24.
kpis.description_en: PA Consulting operating profit. ~22% margin FY25 (premium vs I&AF 8.4%). Reacceleration FY25 after FY22-FY24 plateau.

notes: Jacobs Solutions fiscal year se termine fin septembre (FY24 = oct 2023-sep 2024). Spin-off CMS (Amentum) effectif sept 2024.
